```{r setup, include=FALSE}
setwd("xxx")

#Install packages "data.table", "ggplot2",and "ggpubr"
install.packages("data.table")
library(data.table)
install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
install.packages("ggpubr")  
library(ggpubr)

#Read Figures_4B,C_dat.csv
dat<-fread("Figures_4B,C_dat.csv")

#Install more packages "ggsignif", "dplyr", and "magrittr"  
install.packages("ggsignif")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("magrittr")
library(dplyr)   
library(magrittr) 
library(ggsignif)

#Define Strain as a factor
dat$Strain<-factor(dat$Strain,levels=c("NB","WT","P1","P12","P12+P1","P15"))

#Define SampleID as a factor
dat$SampleID<-as.factor(dat$SampleID)


#Define Immune_elicitor as a factor
dat$Immune_elicitor <- factor(dat$Immune_elicitor, levels = c("Mock_OD0.01","flg22_Dja","Mock_OD0.1","AtPEP1_OD0.1","Mock","AtPEP1","elf18","chitin"))

#Define Root_length as a numeric 
dat$Root_length <- as.numeric(as.character(dat$Root_length))

# Overall normality check
shapiro.test(dat$Root_length)
qqnorm(dat$Root_length)
qqline(dat$Root_length, col = "red")

# Run Shapiro–Wilk test on Concentration values from Mock group
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)

# Subset only rows where Immune_elicitor == "Mock_OD0.01"
mock_OD0.01_data <- subset(dat, Immune_elicitor == "Mock_OD0.01")

mock_OD0.01_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length)

# Subset only rows where Immune_elicitor == "flg22_Dja"
flg22_Dja_data <- subset(dat, Immune_elicitor == "flg22_Dja")

flg22_Dja_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length)

# Subset only rows where Immune_elicitor == "Mock_OD0.1"
mock_OD0.1_data <- subset(dat, Immune_elicitor == "Mock_OD0.1")

mock_OD0.1_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length)

# Subset only rows where Immune_elicitor == "AtPEP1_OD0.1"
AtPEP1_OD0.1_data <- subset(dat, Immune_elicitor == "AtPEP1_OD0.1")

AtPEP1_OD0.1_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length)

# Subset only rows where Immune_elicitor == "Mock"
mock_data <- subset(dat, Immune_elicitor == "Mock")

mock_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length)

# Subset only rows where Immune_elicitor == "AtPEP1"
AtPEP1_data <- subset(dat, Immune_elicitor == "AtPEP1")

# Run Shapiro–Wilk test on Concentration values from chitin group
AtPEP1_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length)

# Subset only rows where Immune_elicitor == "elf18"
elf18_data <- subset(dat, Immune_elicitor == "elf18")

# Run Shapiro–Wilk test on Concentration values from chitin group
elf18_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length)

# Subset only rows where Immune_elicitor == "chitin"
chitin_data <- subset(dat, Immune_elicitor == "chitin")

# Run Shapiro–Wilk test on Concentration values from chitin group
chitin_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length)

# Subset only rows where OD600 == "1"
OD1_data <- filtered_data <- subset(
  dat,
  OD600 == 1 |
    (OD600 == 0 & !Immune_elicitor %in% c(
      "Mock_OD0.01",
      "Mock_OD0.1",
      "flg22_Dja",
      "AtPEP1_OD0.1"
    ))
)

# Run Shapiro–Wilk test on Concentration values from chitin group
OD1_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length) 


# Subset only rows where OD600 == "0.1"
OD0.1_data <- filtered_data <- subset(
  dat,
  OD600 == 0.1 |
    (OD600 == 0 & Immune_elicitor %in% c(
      "Mock_OD0.1",
      "AtPEP1_OD0.1"
    ))
)

# Run Shapiro–Wilk test on Concentration values from chitin group
OD0.1_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length) 


# Subset only rows where OD600 == "0.01"
OD0.01_data <- filtered_data <- subset(
  dat,
  OD600 == 0.01 |
    (OD600 == 0 & Immune_elicitor %in% c(
      "Mock_OD0.01",
      "flg22_Dja"
    ))
)

# Run Shapiro–Wilk test on Concentration values from chitin group
OD0.01_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length) 

#Dunn's test
library(FSA)

Dun_result_dat<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ SampleID, data = dat, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat$res, "Dun_result_dat_SampleID.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_mock_OD0.01<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ Strain, data = mock_OD0.01_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_mock_OD0.01$res, "Dun_result_dat_mock_OD0.01_Strain.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_flg22_Dja<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ Strain, data = flg22_Dja_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_flg22_Dja$res, "Dun_result_dat_flg22_Dja_Strain.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_mock_OD0.1<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ Strain, data = mock_OD0.1_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_mock_OD0.01$res, "Dun_result_dat_mock_OD0.1_Strain.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_AtPEP1_OD0.1<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ Strain, data = AtPEP1_OD0.1_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_AtPEP1_OD0.1$res, "Dun_result_dat_AtPEP1_OD0.1_Strain.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_mock<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ Strain, data = mock_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_mock$res, "Dun_result_dat_mock_Strain.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_AtPEP1<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ Strain, data = AtPEP1_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_AtPEP1$res, "Dun_result_dat_AtPEP1_Strain.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_elf18<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ Strain, data = elf18_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_elf18$res, "Dun_result_dat_elf18_Strain.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_chitin<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ Strain, data = chitin_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_chitin$res, "Dun_result_dat_chitin_Strain.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_OD1<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ SampleID, data = OD1_data , method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_OD1$res, "Dun_result_dat_IEs_OD1_SampleID.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_OD0.1<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ SampleID, data = OD0.1_data , method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_OD0.1$res, "Dun_result_dat_IEs_OD0.1_SampleID.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_OD0.01<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ SampleID, data = OD0.01_data , method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_OD0.01$res, "Dun_result_dat_IEs_OD0.01_SampleID.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# Define a 6-color palette 
strain_col13 <- c(
  "NB" = "#0c74b9",
  "WT" = "#d55427",
  "P1" = "#e5ae23",
  "P12" = "#802f89",
  "P12+P1" = "#74a641",
  "P15" = "#5abbea"
)

#Define strain_labels
strain_labels <- c(
  "P1"      = expression(Delta * italic("ppiD")),
  "P12"     = expression(Delta * italic("tonB1::Gm"^"R")),
  "P12+P1"  = expression(Delta * italic("tonB1::Gm"^"R")*Delta * italic("ppiD")),
  "P15"  = expression(Delta * italic("trps")))
#trps:"trpE-BLR19_RS02895-trpG-trpD-trpC"

#Run ggplot for making a boxplot
p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = Strain, y = Root_length,fill = Strain)) + 
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, color = "black", size = 0.6,alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Strain), size = 3, alpha = 0.6,
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Immune_elicitor, ncol = 4, labeller = labeller(Immune_elicitor = c("Mock_OD0.01" = "Mock_OD600=0.01","flg22_Dja" = "flg22-Dja_OD600=0.01","Mock_OD0.1" = "Mock_OD600=0.1","AtPEP1_OD0.1" = "AtPEP1_OD600=0.1","Mock" = "Mock_OD600=1","AtPEP1" = "AtPEP1_OD600=1","elf18" = "elf18_OD600=1", "chitin" = "chitin_OD600=1"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = strain_col13,labels = strain_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(values = strain_col13,labels = strain_labels) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Root elongation (cm)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(size = 2),
    axis.line = element_line(size = 1.2),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5),
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", color = "black"),  # facet title size
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 10)) 

#Show the boxplot
p

#Save the boxplot as a tiff file
ggsave("Figures 4B,C.tif", plot = p, width = 16, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "tiff",compression = "lzw")

#Save the boxplot as svg file
ggsave("Figures 4B,C.svg", plot = p, width = 16, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "svg")
```
